headline: President: next year universal cash handout of NT$10,000; overall defense budget breaks the NT$1 trillion mark for the first time [video] | Politics
summary: President Lai Ching-te said the 2027 central government budget, premised on a balanced budget and near-zero new borrowing, adds NT$235.7 billion to fund the handout. Overall defense spending reaches NT$1.1225 trillion.
why: The central government budget sets fiscal priorities, spending levels and borrowing needs, which influence growth and sovereign credit assessments.
